question_text:
Which of the following sentences is the most concise and free from redundancy?

A) The administrative officer will collaborate together with the division chiefs to finalize the new policy.
B) The administrative officer will collaborate with the division chiefs to finalize the new policy.
C) The administrative officer will collaborate together with the division chiefs in order to finalize the new policy.
D) The administrative officer will collaborate with the division chiefs for the purpose of finalizing the new policy.
